name: Finished canopy bed and bedding inserts
prompt:
Create ONE detailed source-compatible GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, not a mesh or whole new room. Title INT-BED-DRESS-001 — Finished canopy bed and bedding inserts. Pale ivory background, soft even light, crisp isolated non-melting forms. Full sheet ID, numbered suffix and names printed clearly, dimensions W,D,H marked PROPOSED. Same original rose/ivory marble, fine gold rose/star/lotus ornament, indigo and blush textiles. Use only single supplied reference for visible style; unseen construction is proposed. No people, scenery or unlabeled extra objects. Exactly10 separate object cells with readable shape, one three-quarter or unfolded primary view and a small rear/underside/contact view. Do not fuse objects together. Use a5x2 grid for TEN inserts. Include ONE small completed-bed ASSEMBLY GUIDE above or below grid using the supplied existing frame unchanged, mattress/sheet/duvet, two copies of sleeping pillow and canopy textile pieces. This guide is NOT an eleventh new asset. Existing frame has four posts and open canopy rim: preserve its exact recognizable headboard, slender ivory posts and gold lotus feet. Bedding looks soft and celebratory, human scale, never architectural size. Do not redesign the frame or add nightstands. No separate flower garland, pillow cushion, tassel, mirror or curtain track duplicated here; those already exist or are queued separately.

INT-BED-DRESS-001-A01 — Mattress. W,D,H [2, 2.2, 0.28]m proposed. One plain ivory mattress with crisp rounded rectangular edges and subtle quilt stitching. No frame or pillows. Base fits existing frame slat seat.

INT-BED-DRESS-001-A02 — Fitted ivory sheet. W,D,H [2, 2.2, 0.29]m proposed. One thin removable fitted-sheet shell, ivory with tiny gold stitched hem, elastic return lip underneath. Show underside hollow shell; not a second solid mattress.

INT-BED-DRESS-001-A03 — Blush duvet. W,D,H [2.4, 2.5, 0.08]m proposed. One soft blush-pink duvet with restrained quilted rose/star embroidery and ivory piping, gently draped rectangular panel. Show clear thin edge, no pillows or bed.

INT-BED-DRESS-001-A04 — Sleeping pillow. W,D,H [0.7, 0.45, 0.16]m proposed. ONE ivory rectangular sleeping pillow, blush piping and small embroidered rose corner; duplicate twice on bed. Not an inseparable pillow pair.

INT-BED-DRESS-001-A05 — Long sheer canopy curtain. W,D,H [0.9, 0.03, 2.3]m proposed. One full-length translucent ivory-pink canopy curtain, visible header loops, gentle vertical folds and stitched lower hem; no attached gold post. Reuse four copies.

INT-BED-DRESS-001-A06 — Head canopy valance. W,D,H [2.2, 0.06, 0.32]m proposed. One SHORT canopy valance strip for head/foot edge, indigo satin with gold stars and blush scalloped lower fringe. Straight top mounting edge, no curtain body.

INT-BED-DRESS-001-A07 — Side canopy valance. W,D,H [2.7, 0.06, 0.32]m proposed. One LONG canopy valance strip matching previous strip but2.7m long. Ends plain so corners can meet; show reverse header sleeve.

INT-BED-DRESS-001-A08 — Side bed skirt. W,D,H [2.7, 0.02, 0.4]m proposed. One pleated blush bed-skirt side strip with gold lower hem, straight top attachment band. Thin fabric, no bedframe. Long side piece only.

INT-BED-DRESS-001-A09 — Foot bed skirt. W,D,H [2.2, 0.02, 0.4]m proposed. One shorter pleated foot skirt strip matching side skirt,2.2m long. Thin shell and straight header; no full bed or floor.

INT-BED-DRESS-001-A10 — Embroidered bed-foot runner. W,D,H [2.3, 0.55, 0.015]m proposed. One narrow indigo-and-blush gold-star runner draped across foot of bed;2.3m width includes side overhang. Broad textile face visible, not a rug or duvet.
Footer: Proposed reference components; shape consistency, fit and mesh separation require modeling review.
